## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the commands and operating systems used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and `npm run format:check`.
- [ ] I inspected the npm package with `npm run check:package-brand`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I used only fake credentials and isolated test directories.
- [ ] I preserved unrelated TOML, JSONC or YAML content where applicable.
- [ ] I considered preview, atomic apply, conflict detection and rollback behavior.
- [ ] I considered Windows, macOS and Linux behavior.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` and user documentation where needed.
- [ ] This change does not expand the supported client list without prior maintainer agreement.
